# Anthony Tulk

- **Age:** School-age (around 9-11 years old in Volume 1, advancing in classes in Volume 2)  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive; Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orphaned nephew brought to live in Brierley with Laurence Tulk's family  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, small, gloomy face with dark, glaring eyes and a cheekily confident swagger.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Personality

Anthony is a cheeky, rebellious, and independent boy who initially holds a grudge and shows open disdain for female teachers. He is clever, cheeky, and stubborn, preferring to follow his own opinions rather than be easily swayed. Although he begins with an aggressive and disrespectful attitude, he gains respect for authority and shows loyalty once he feels a teacher has proven herself to be capable.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P11](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0011), [v2 c12 P48](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0048), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## History

Anthony Tulk is taken in as an orphan by Mrs. Laurence Tulk in Brierley and begins attending the local school. He quickly establishes a reputation for being cheeky and holding a strong prejudice against female teachers. During Nell Harcourt's tenure as teacher, Anthony continually shows open disrespect and insolence toward her. On a particularly stressful day, Anthony places a mouse in Nell's desk drawer; when confronted, he insolently admits to it, prompting Nell to lose her temper and give him a whipping with a hardwood pointer. Surprisingly, this punishment earns Anthony's respect, causing him to become polite, carry Nell's books, and defend her competence to others. He later joins the extra class preparing for the Regent's Entrance examination and successfully passes the entrance tests.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P29](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0029), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c30 P20](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0020)_
